title: Aaj Koofey main Shabbir-o-Shabbar ro rahe hain
body:
Aaj Koofey main Shabbir-o-Shabbar ro rahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj Koofey main Shabbir-o-Shabbar ro rahe hain
Baap ko apne Zehra ke dilbar ro rahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Behrobar mein hae ghul aaj barpa waa Ali ka
Aaj Jibreel arshe bareen par ro rahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaj shehzadiyaan hain pareshaan shahe zeeshan
Uthke taskeen doh behre daawar ro rahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye yateemoun ke baywoun ke waali shahe aali
Ab na waaris raha koi sar par ro rahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Hae janaaze pah ek shor barpah bekasoun ka
Baap se lipte Shabbir-o-Shabbar ro rahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Qaak udatey hain sar par nawaase Mustafa ke
Ghar se jaata hae taabotey Hyder ro rahe hain
<<DIVIDER>>
Aye Himayat azadaare Hyder peeth kar sar
Aaj is tere nauhe ko sunkar ro rahe hain
